title: Ask HN: Gmail account security
author: caseyf7
excerpt: I have a gmail account that I rarely use, but I know the password. I enter it correctly and get the following message: You’re trying to sign in on a device Google doesn’t recognize, and we don’t have enough information to verify that it’s you. For your protection, you can’t sign in here right now. Try again from a device or location where you’ve signed in before. Even if I get the code from the recovery email account, it won't work. Is this the AI hell Google throws you into
guide_zh: 用户知道密码却因设备验证无法登录 Gmail，询问解决办法。
